St. Xavier’s College Autonomous
		

--

					
St. Xavier's College, 
Mumbai.

--
					

Empowered Autonomous Institute

				
--

									
Not just a college – it’s a way of life!
								

--

					
College Calendar
				

--

									
At St. Xavier’s College, we foster an environment of holistic growth, promoting academic, social, and personal development. Our range of student-led initiatives and best practices enrich campus life and ensure that students have access to diverse opportunities for learning and social contribution.
								

--
